title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1973-11-17

ai_review.summary: A pristine 1973 soundboard capture with crisp mix and a smoking Here Come Sunshine plus the legendary Playin' In The Band sandwich.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb, crystal‑clear soundboard source that even beats other IA copies, despite a few patched sections. Musically the show is tight and high‑energy, highlighted by an inspired Here Come Sunshine, soaring China Cat > I Know You Rider, emotive Looks Like Rain, and the monumental Playin' In The Band → Uncle John's Band → Morning Dew medley.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews praise both the performance (tight, high‑energy, standout songs) and the recording (crisp, superior soundboard), yielding a near‑perfect combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix with excellent balance; some reviewers note minor splices/patches but overall superior to other IA versions.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Morning Dew (within the Playin' In The Band sandwich)
Playin' In The Band > Uncle John's Band > Morning Dew
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set launches without a warm‑up, staying tight and on cue; the famed Playin' In The Band sandwich provides a seamless, high‑impact climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers soaring solos and picking that lift the performance; his tone is praised as perfect.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir supplies cool rhythm fills that enhance tracks like Tennessee Jed and the Playin' sandwich.
